subject.title: Session transcript doomloop: crash-restart cycle inflates transcript until gateway OOMs

question: What default recovery behavior should OpenClaw use when an active session transcript is too large or repeatedly crashes the gateway on reload?
rationale: Automation can prove the current unsafe path, but it cannot safely choose whether existing sessions should be truncated, quarantined, skipped, compacted, or repaired by doctor without maintainer policy.

options.title: Define Recovery Boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the default degraded-session behavior before implementing the full transcript recovery fix.

options.title: Land Bootstrap Cap First
options.body: Port and prove the open bootstrap-marker PR as a partial mitigation while this issue remains open for transcript loading and recovery.

options.title: Split Subsystems
options.body: Move bootstrap caps, transcript size recovery, media dedupe, and doctor UX into separate canonical issues while preserving this issue as the umbrella.

recommendation.title: Define Recovery Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the default degraded-session behavior before implementing the full transcript recovery fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent high-confidence history on the bootstrap/context-injection path and are a good routing owner for the policy decision.
